verdict.rationale: Databricks documents a no-cost Free Edition workspace for exploring datasets and experimenting (it replaced Community Edition), plus a self-serve free trial account. The getting-started tutorials show querying sample data in Unity Catalog, which supports self-serve evaluation without a sales call. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that no credit card is required, documented Free Edition limits on compute and data, evidence of loading and querying your own real data in the free tier, and independent hands-on corroboration of the signup flow.
